purpose: Recall reference list for ONE bounded segment (workstream F2): Belgian B2B software companies with a publicly reachable partner page.
segment: Belgian-headquartered B2B software vendors, any size, with a partner/reseller page on their own domain.
constructionRule: Assembled by hand from sector knowledge of the Belgian B2B software market, WITHOUT running discovery and without consulting any discovery output. Every entry is then verified mechanically: it counts as a reference member only if a partner page is actually retrievable on its own domain. Companies that fail verification are dropped from the denominator rather than counted as misses, because a company with no public partner page is not something discovery could be expected to find.
limits: This is a convenience list, not an enumeration of the segment. It cannot support a claim about the true size of the Belgian B2B software population, so recall here is recall against THIS list and nothing more.
